name: iPhone 12 pro
description:
Features:

  • Surgical-Grade Stainless Steel Frame: Durable, premium, and sleek design.

  • A14 Bionic Chip: Advanced performance and power efficiency.

  • LiDAR Scanner: Enhances AR and improves low-light autofocus.
  • 5G Connectivity: Ultra-fast wireless speeds for downloading and streaming.
